builtwith.no_key: BuiltWith key not set in Settings: module not applicable
module.builtwith.checks: Queries BuiltWith (optional key) for the domain's technology history by category, with first and last detection dates.
module.builtwith.fix:
Go through the detected technologies by category, with their first and last detection dates, and compare them with the inventory of what you really run (servers, CMS, libraries, third-party services). Any technology nobody recognizes needs investigating.
Tool removed from the site but still detected (old chat, analytics, form, advertising pixel, former host): check that it has really gone (tags and scripts removed from the templates), close the account, revoke the API keys and delete the DNS record (`CNAME`) that pointed to that service, to avoid a subdomain takeover.
Old versions or end-of-life technologies: update or replace them, starting with those exposed to the Internet. Cross-check with the Technologies and Technology vulnerabilities modules of the scan to see which have published flaws.
Tracking, advertising and third-party tools detected: check that they appear in your processing register and in the cookie consent banner, and remove those whose use is no longer justified: every third-party script is a security dependency.
Reduce what is visible from outside: remove version numbers from headers (`Server`, `X-Powered-By`), the `generator` tag and code comments.
BuiltWith is a third-party source, sometimes weeks behind the real site: confirm each sensitive point on the site itself (source code, headers with `curl -sI https://example.com`) before acting.
Keep an up-to-date inventory and compare this result with the previous scan's after every major change, to spot any new or unexpected technology.
module.builtwith.title: BuiltWith
module.builtwith.why: BuiltWith sees what a single page does not show: removed tools, old versions, technologies on other pages of the site.
